text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
text_cn: 达味训诲歌，交与乐官，和以弦乐。

text_en: Give ear to my prayer, O God; do not hide yourself from my supplication.
text_cn: 天主，求你侧耳倾听我的祈祷， 求你不要回避我的哀告。

text_en: Attend to me, and answer me; I am troubled in my complaint. I am distraught
text_cn: 求你俯视我，并垂允我， 我痛苦忧伤，叹息悲号：

text_en: by the noise of the enemy, because of the clamor of the wicked. For they bring trouble upon me, and in anger they cherish enmity against me.
text_cn: 由于仇敌的叫嚣，并因恶人的吵闹， 因加于我的灾祸，怒中给我的骚扰，

text_en: My heart is in anguish within me, the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
text_cn: 我的心在我胸内焦灼， 死亡的恐怖笼罩了我，

text_en: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror overwhelms me.
text_cn: 惊惧与战栗侵袭了我， 恐怖与烦恼淹没了我。

text_en: And I say, “O that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest;
text_cn: 我于是说：“但愿我有鸽子般的翅膀， 为能飞翔而去，栖身安藏！”

text_en: truly, I would flee far away; I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah
text_cn: 看，我必要逃往远处， 在荒凉的地方暂住；（休止）

text_en: I would hurry to find a shelter for myself from the raging wind and tempest. ”
text_cn: 从速寻找一个避难所， 避过这一场风狂雨暴。

text_en: Confuse, O Lord, confound their speech; for I see violence and strife in the city.
text_cn: 我主，求你分散扰乱他们的语言， 因我在城中只见到斗争与纷乱：

text_en: Day and night they go around it on its walls, and iniquity and trouble are within it;
text_cn: 他们日夜在城墙上巡行， 邪恶与欺压在城中丛生。

text_en: ruin is in its midst; oppression and fraud do not depart from its marketplace.
text_cn: 城池中已满布诡计， 霸道欺诈横行街市。

text_en: It is not enemies who taunt me— I could bear that; it is not adversaries who deal insolently with me— I could hide from them.
text_cn: 若是我的仇人辱骂我，我还可容忍； 若是恼恨我者欺凌我，我尚可退隐；

text_en: But it is you, my equal, my companion, my familiar friend,
text_cn: 可惜是你，我的同僚， 我的伙伴，我的友好；

text_en: with whom I kept pleasant company; we walked in the house of God with the throng.
text_cn: 我们曾经推心置腹，无所讳言， 在人群中走进了天主的圣殿。

text_en: Let death come upon them; let them go down alive to Sheol; for evil is in their homes and in their hearts.
text_cn: 愿死亡突袭他们，活活的堕入阴府！ 因为他们的居处和内心满是恶毒。

text_en: But I call upon God, and the Lord will save me.
text_cn: 但我却要呼号天主， 上主必定予我救助。

text_en: Evening and morning and at noon I utter my complaint and moan, and he will hear my voice.
text_cn: 不论在黄昏在清晨或在中午， 我哀声悲叹，他必听我的苦诉。

text_en: He will redeem me unharmed from the battle that I wage, for many are arrayed against me.
text_cn: 他必从迫害我的人中，救我安然脱险， 因为那些反对我的人，实在众多难算。

text_en: God, who is enthroned from of old, Selah will hear, and will humble them— because they do not change, and do not fear God.
text_cn: 永远为王的天主必要俯听我，而把他们赶走，（休止） 因为他们不知回心转意，而又不知敬畏天主。

text_en: My companion laid hands on a friend and violated a covenant with me
text_cn: 他们伸手攻击自己的友好， 他们任意违背订立的盟约。

text_en: with speech smoother than butter, but with a heart set on war; with words that were softer than oil, but in fact were drawn swords.
text_cn: 他们的容貌比奶油更光滑，心却是好战； 他们的言语比脂粉还柔和，但口蜜腹剑。

text_en: Cast your burden on the Lord , and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.
text_cn: 将你的重担卸交上主，他必扶持你， 他绝对不会让义人永远动摇不止。

text_en: But you, O God, will cast them down into the lowest pit; the bloodthirsty and treacherous shall not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.
text_cn: 天主，求你使他们堕入灭亡的深穴！ 凶手和奸诈的歹徒必定中年夭折。 上主，但我却要时常一心唯你是赖。
